vendors.name: SisFood
vendors.reason: Brazilian restaurant / food-truck system (PDV + own commission-free digital menu); its food-truck page has customers order from the truck's menu link for pickup ('para buscar'), and its digital menu takes pickup at a chosen time and orders up to 60 days ahead; R$ price from the home page FAQ. Readable today (403 in compare-research-1). BORDERLINE price: the food-truck page's FAQ says the package is modular and priced with a specialist, while the home FAQ gives 'A partir de R$ 149,90/mês' including 'cardápio digital próprio'

plans.note: home page FAQ 'Quanto custa o SisFood?', read today; continues 'Alguns módulos são cobrados à parte, como NFC-e, NF-e, autoatendiment…'. The food-truck page FAQ instead says: 'O valor depende do que entra no pacote, então o melhor caminho é falar com um especialista' and lists 'cardápio digital' among features you 'ativa … conforme o food truck cresce' — so whether the R$ 149,90 entry price covers the digital menu for a food truck is BORDERLINE (the home FAQ says it is included).
